description: AI-native BuildOS for Codex, Claude Code, Doubao, WorkBuddy and ZCode: product discovery, UI/UX design, software engineering, context-aware workflows, testing, Git and verifiable releases.

summary.zh: 明确已授权目标内的持续推进、必要澄清和安全门禁边界，并让项目 AGENTS.md 只维护项目事实与差异规则，减少重复确认和跨层冲突。
summary.en: Clarify continued execution within authorized outcomes, material clarification and safety gates, while keeping project AGENTS.md files focused on project facts and delta rules to reduce redundant confirmations and cross-layer conflicts.
summary.ja: 承認済みの目的内での継続実行、必要な確認、安全ゲートの境界を明確にし、プロジェクトの AGENTS.md を固有事実と差分規則に絞ることで、重複確認と階層間の競合を減らします。
